lines.text: Just a heads up, the meeting starts early.

data.define: Early information so someone can be ready.

example.text: Just a heads up, the meeting starts early.

misuse.text: Don't say 'heads up' after the problem happens.

data.l1_hook: एक "heads up": बॉस आ रहा है।
data.l1_ex: बस "heads up", मीटिंग जल्दी शुरू होगी।
